strings.jp: 勇者を夢見た一般人カナン

剣の腕に伸び悩みを感じた彼は
やがて軍を抜け、以後一般人として
平穏な日々を送ったという…
strings.en:
Feeling his swordplay had
stalled, he soon left the army,
and from then on lived peaceful
days as a commoner...

strings.jp:
軍隊の厳しさを痛感した彼は
その後軍を抜け、民間人となり
静かな余生を送ったという…
strings.en:
Painfully aware of how harsh
army life was, he left the army,
became a civilian, and lived out
a quiet life...

strings.jp:
才は並ながら剣術に目覚めた彼は
民間人に戻ってからも剣の修行を続け
それなりの腕前になったという…
strings.en:
Of only average talent but
awakened to the sword, he kept
training even as a civilian, and
became fairly skilled...

strings.jp:
戦いの中で弛まぬ修行を続けた彼は
人間的にも磨きがかかり
以後も優れた軍人としての日々を
送ったという…
strings.en:
Training tirelessly through the
battles, he grew as a person
too, and went on to live his
days as a fine soldier...

strings.jp:
戦いの中でその才能を開花させた彼は
各地で輝かしい戦績を上げ続け
百年に一人の逸材と賞賛されたという…
strings.en:
His talent blossoming in battle,
he kept winning brilliant
victories everywhere, hailed as
a once-in-a-century prodigy...

strings.jp:
類稀なる剣の才能に恵まれた彼は
何者をも寄せ付けぬ力を発揮し
剣聖の再臨と謳われたという…
strings.en:
Blessed with a rare gift for the
sword, he showed power none
could rival, and was hailed as
the Sword Saint reborn...
